name: Insecure Supply Chain
definition: Degree to which the system's supply chain is secure, auditable, and resistant to vulnerabilities in third-party components.

values.name: Secure and Auditable
values.definition: Secure and auditable supply chain, with formal verification of all third-party components and dependencies.

values.name: Strong Practices
values.definition: Strong supply chain security practices in place, minimizing the risk of supply chain attacks.

values.name: Some Measures
values.definition: Some measures to mitigate supply chain risks, but vulnerabilities may still exist in third-party components.

values.name: High Risk
values.definition: High risk of supply chain vulnerabilities, with no or minimal measures to ensure the security of third-party components and dependencies.
